title: Airport Low-Altitude Airspace Monitoring Application
description:
Airport Low-Altitude Airspace Monitoring Application
For airport perimeter airspace management, the system combines radio-spectrum analysis, airspace situational display, event logging, and command platform integration. It supports continuous monitoring, target classification, alert review, and coordinated response procedures for airport operation teams. Monitoring data, electronic maps, and response plans can be organized in a unified platform for collaboration with air traffic, public safety, and site security teams.
